snippets.code:
<script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".ribbon-btn .elementor-button"
    );

    const tabContents = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".tab-content"
    );

    buttons.forEach(button => {

        button.addEventListener("click", function(e){

            e.preventDefault();

            const target = button.getAttribute("href");

            if(!target || !target.startsWith("#")) return;

            tabContents.forEach(content => {
                content.style.display = "none";
            });

            buttons.forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.remove("active-ribbon");
            });

            const activeContent = document.querySelector(target);

            if(activeContent){
                activeContent.style.display = "block";
            }

            button.classList.add("active-ribbon");

        });
    });

    if(buttons.length > 0){
        buttons[0].click();
    }

});

</script>

<style>

html{
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

.tab-content{
    display: none;
}

.ribbon-btn .elementor-button{
    transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
}

.ribbon-btn .elementor-button.active-ribbon{
    background: #f4c400 !important;
    border-color: #f4c400 !important;
}

.ribbon-btn .elementor-button.active-ribbon span{
    color: #000 !important;
}

.sticky-ribbon{
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 9999;
}

</style>
